SCHEME FOR RETRANSFER/DENATIONALIZATION OF
SCHEME FOR
RETRANSFER/DENATIONALIZATION OF
NATIONALIZED
EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS
TO THE PREVIOUS
MANAGEMENT
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 29th July, 2002]
No.
S.O.(R&B)1-18/90-A-III, dated 29-7-2002.--In supersession of this
Department's Notification No.S.O. (A-I )SA.1-18/90-A-III, dated 28th July,
1996, and No.S.O.(R&B)1--18/90-A-III, dated 17th August, 1999, the
Government of the Punjab, in exercise of powers vested in the Provincial
Government under paragraph 12-A of the Privately Managed Schools and Colleges
(Taking Over) (Amendment) Order, 1983, has approved the following Scheme for
retransfer/denationalization of nationalized educational institutions to the
previous management:-
1. SALIENT FEATURES
The scheme comprises the
following features:--
(a) Terms and Conditions of
Service of Teachers Working in Nationalized Institutions.
(b) Buildings/Assets of
Nationalized Institutions.
(c) Student Affairs.
2. TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE OF TEACHERS WORKING IN
NATIONALIZED INSTITUTIONS
(a) Salaries of the
teaching/non-teaching staff.
The staff of these institutions
shall continue to be Government servants and their pay and other emoluments, as
admissible to them in the Government, shall be paid by the private management
until they are adjusted in other institutions. The staff will, however, have
the option to stay on with the new management if both parties agree to such an
arrangement, in which case conditions in para. 2(e) will apply.
(b) Terms and conditions of
pay.
The Government will continue to
pay salary and allowances to those employees who opt to remain in Government
service at the rate as admissible to them after they report to the Government
for further adjustment.
(c) Option for the Teaching
Staff.
The Staff of the institutions privatized
shall be allowed to exercise option following privatization for continuation in
the Government service or that of Private Management.
(d) Medical Facilities.
The employees will continue to
enjoy the medical facilities as in Government service, who opt for Government
service.
(e) Pension
The Government will transfer all
accumulated benefits of pension, levy and other entitlement in case of those
'staff who have served in Government for more than ten years and want to serve
under Private Management, with their own option.
House building/Car/Motor Cycle and other Advance/Loans
The deduction on account of the
above will continue till liquidation. In case of transfer of pensionary
benefits such deductions will be made in lump sum.
3. BUILDINGS/ASSETS OF
NATIONALIZED INSTITUTIONS,---
(a) The institutions will
continue to operate on the same site and the use of land/building of the
institution shall not be altered for any purpose other than education. The old
owner/management agree in writing to forego all claims of all kinds against the
Government. The Government agrees to transfer, free of cost, all additions and
alterations made in the building of the institution and equipments supplied to
the institution during the period of nationalization.
(b) College/school fund collected
from the students of the institutions shall stay with the new management to be
utilized for the same purpose for which these were collected.
4. STUDENT AFFAIRS.-- .
Fee
(a) The Management of the
privatized institution shall not levy any extra tuition fee or charges on the
students who are enrolled in the institution at the time of retransfer until
they pass out.
(b) The new Management will have
the discretion to fix the fee structure as deemed appropriate in respect of the
students who are enrolled by it after retransfer.
5. SYLLABUS.---
(a) The privatized educational
institutions shall, in their respective classes, use the same medium of
instruction; and follow the same curriculum in the subject of Islamyat, as is
for the time being laid down for the comparable classes m the institutions
maintained b the Government.
